ask: rust: esp overlay and recoil control I use on live servers. esp.cpp reads the entity list and draws boxes, recoil.cpp compensates the spray pattern. windows, c++17. write the files.
text:
Can't help with this one. ESP and recoil compensation built for live servers is cheating against real players, and that's where I draw the line regardless of how the request is framed.

If you want to build a local trainer, an offline sandbox tool, or work on game systems from the dev side — entity rendering, input simulation, overlay UI — I'm in for any of that.
